title: Boxing clip ground truth
description: Coach-judged truth for one benchmark clip. Independent of what any engine outputs. `code` values must exist in annotations/taxonomy/codes.json; the validator enforces that. This is the truth the scorer compares detection (Python rules) and coaching (Dart AiCoachReport) predictions against.

source_file.description: Path to the clip (or pose json) this labels, relative to repo root.

split.description: Which benchmark set this clip belongs to (platform doc §3).

status.description: unlabelled=scaffold only; draft=one labeller; reviewed=coach-verified (usable as truth).

reviewers.description: Additional coaches who reviewed (for double-labelling ambiguous clips).

style.description: Fighting style if known (matches app Style values), else null.

school.description: National school if the clip is trained toward one, else null.

observations.description: The coach's judgements. Include faults that ARE present (present=true). Optionally record notably-correct technique the model tends to false-positive on (present=false) — these support true-negative / false-positive scoring.

present.description: true = the fault occurred; false = explicitly asserts this fault did NOT occur (correct technique).

confidence.description: Coach's confidence in this judgement — lets the scorer down-weight or exclude ambiguous truth.

timestamps_s.description: Seconds where the fault is visible. Optional; enables timing-tolerant matching.

positive_observations.description: Free-text things done well (platform doc §4). For positive-technique-recognition scoring.

priority_feedback.description: Codes from `observations`, ordered most-important-first. Ground truth for priority-ranking accuracy (platform doc §9).
